costs.scope: Indexed completed cells only. Development includes all candidates; formal includes the frozen selected candidate. Unindexed attempts are excluded and counted separately.

definitions.subprocess_seconds: Sum of child_exit process_seconds, including failed exited attempts for indexed cells. This is elapsed subprocess time, not GPU utilization-hours or controller elapsed time. Null unless every indexed cell has matched start/exit events and a successful exit; recorded_subprocess_seconds retains the observed exited-attempt sum.
definitions.components: Sum each checkpoint's non-cumulative training, post-hoc correction, buffer selection and evaluation timer once. Components are not added to subprocess elapsed time; startup, data loading, saving and other overhead are not included in these component timers.
definitions.optimizer_steps: Base steps include SS-IL's modified training workload. Post-hoc steps are separate BiC/CBF optimization; closed-form WA (whose records omit this counter) and SS-IL have zero post-hoc optimizer steps. SS-IL extra replay/distillation time is included in training_seconds, not isolated as correction_seconds.
definitions.aggregation: Rows are overlapping views: overall, phase, and phase/dataset/base/correction. Sum within one view only; never sum rows across aggregation levels.

definitions.levels: Precision, recall, F1 and aggregate metrics are fractions; paired metric differences are percentage points. Count differences use examples.
definitions.aggregation: Exact paired seeds 1,2,3,4,42; arithmetic mean and sample SD (ddof=1). Missing/undefined quantities remain null; n and complete are explicit.
definitions.recall_roles: Per checkpoint, new classes are that checkpoint's introduced classes; old classes are previously introduced classes. New/old macro recall is the unweighted mean of all role classes, null if empty or unsupported.
definitions.empty_class_f1: Undefined class F1 is null; the separate zero macro_f1_term preserves the original macro convention for fully empty classes.
definitions.selection: Hyperparameters frozen from training-held-out development seeds 5/6 only. Reporting best corrected configuration is one complete five-seed mean, never per-seed maxima, and is descriptive rather than a new hyperparameter selection.
definitions.closure: (corrected mean Macro-F1 - unchanged S2000 fixed-best mean)/(original Joint mean - unchanged S2000 fixed-best mean). Same-base improvement is separately reported and is NOT the closure numerator. No clipping to [0,1].
definitions.closure_gate: Thresholds use ratio of five-seed means, not mean seed ratios. Nonpositive dataset denominator (including NSL) makes closure undefined. Strict main rule uses same correction plus same base role across UNSW/CIC; cross-base alternatives are sensitivity only.
definitions.portable: Portable mode verifies index/result/metrics-sidecar/frozen-selection hashes and recorded identities. Checkpoint hashes retain original weight provenance but no actual .pt bytes are read; this is not fresh payload verification.
definitions.research_scope: Bounded Section23/RQ2 comparison of adapted borrowed methods, not proof of novelty or overall research completion. Original eight-epoch Joint is unchanged; runtime/hardware are not matched.

section23_4.confirmed_rule: User-confirmed solved condition requires the same correction and base role across UNSW/CIC17; dataset-specific fixed-best base methods may differ. Cross-base success alone does not satisfy this criterion.
section23_4.reason: Even each target dataset's best fixed corrected configuration closes <30%
